name: MailMenu_Run
evidence: Mail menu (6 plates: send/receive, write mail, mailbox, address book, profile, mail server; screenshot 'mail_menu' at frame 16224): loads gfx, initial item from SRAM 1:$A8B8; returns A=item 1-6 on A, 0 on B; called from 7C:7BC0

name: MailMenu_Loop
evidence: Per-frame loop: 00:0956 sprites, 00:044B wait VBlank, Joypad_UpdateIdleFrames (7D:7BA4)/7BC1, call JoypadDispatch with Table_MailMenu_Buttons

name: Table_MailMenu_Buttons
evidence: JoypadDispatch inline table (5 words): A -> MailMenu_OnA, B -> MailMenu_OnB, Select/Start ignored (MailMenu_Ignore), none -> MailMenu_Idle

name: MailMenu_Idle
evidence: No A/B/Select/Start: Ticker_Update (48:4223), D-pad with key repeat (hJoyPressedRepeat & $F0) -> MailMenu_HandleDpad, MailMenu_AnimateIcon, loop

name: MailMenu_OnA
evidence: A pressed: sound id $2C (stub 00:20AC), fade out (Palette_FadeOutWithTicker (48:46C6)/4460), write item wRam_C0E5 to SRAM bank 1 $A8B8 (WriteByteFar (48:4616)), return A=item; 7C:7BC6 dispatches on it (1 send/receive ... 6 mail server)

name: MailMenu_OnB
evidence: B pressed: sound id $2E, fade out, write 0 to SRAM 1:$A8B8, return A=0 (back to top menu, jump table entry 0 = ret)

name: MailMenu_Ignore
evidence: Select and Start entries of the JoypadDispatch table: jp MailMenu_Loop

name: MailMenu_GetLabelIndexA
evidence: Returns A=1 if the byte at SRAM bank 0 $A000 is 0, else 6: picks the text pair of item 2 (write-mail vs 'メールをかくにん' when a draft exists)

name: MailMenu_HandleDpad
evidence: Up (bit6): previous item (item 1 wraps to 6), Down (bit7): next item (6 wraps to 1); redraws plates, plays cursor sound id $29

name: MailMenu_AfterMove
evidence: Plays sound id $29 (stub 00:20AC) and restarts the scrolling description ticker of the item via Ticker_Start (48:42D4) (string index at $43FA, item text index from MailMenu_GetLabelIndexB)

name: MailMenu_GetLabelIndexB
evidence: Duplicate of MailMenu_GetLabelIndexA (A=1 if SRAM 0:$A000 == 0 else 6); used by MailMenu_AfterMove

name: MailMenu_DrawItemNormal
evidence: Draws plate of item wRam_C0E6 (the previously selected one) in normal style: 10-column rectangle from Tilemap_MailMenu_PlatesNormal at offset Data_MailMenu_PlateOffsets[c] into the tile buffer (00:16A2)

name: MailMenu_GetPlateIndexA
evidence: Returns A=1 if SRAM 0:$A000 == 0 else 7: plate graphic index for item 2 (normal plates)

name: Table_MailMenu_PlateBufferOffsets
evidence: 8 words: tile-buffer offsets (row*32+9, rows 0,3,5,8,10,13) added to $D000 to place plate c (words 7-8 unused); read by MailMenu_DrawItemNormal (ld hl,$430D)

name: Data_MailMenu_PlateOffsets
evidence: 8 bytes 00 28 46 6E 8C B4 00 D2: offset of plate c inside Tilemap_MailMenu_PlatesNormal (rows of 10 tiles, 4 rows = $28 bytes per plate)

name: MailMenu_DrawItemSelected
evidence: Draws the selected item wRam_C0E5 in highlighted style from Tilemap_MailMenu_PlatesSelected (same scheme as MailMenu_DrawItemNormal); called on entry and after every move

name: MailMenu_GetPlateIndexB
evidence: Duplicate of MailMenu_GetPlateIndexA for the selected plates (A=1 or 7)

name: Table_MailMenu_SelectedBufferOffsets
evidence: Copy of Table_MailMenu_PlateBufferOffsets used by MailMenu_DrawItemSelected (ld hl,$4383)

name: Data_MailMenu_SelectedPlateOffsets
evidence: Copy of Data_MailMenu_PlateOffsets (00 28 46 6E 8C B4 00 D2) used by MailMenu_DrawItemSelected

name: MailMenu_AnimateIcon
evidence: Every $1E frames toggles wRam_C0E8 and copies the 6x8 mail icon frame (Tilemap_MailMenu_IconFrames $4C51 or $4C81) to $D0C1 (00:16A2), then sprites + tile upload: the animated envelope

name: Data_MailMenu_StringIndexBank

name: Table_MailMenu_StringsTail
